title: Excel for Data Analysis
summary: P1 turns a confident formula writer into an analyst: clean and combine real exports, summarise them with PivotTables, find what drives the numbers, test what-if questions, forecast, and say honestly what the data does and doesn’t show.
prereq: Builds on C1 · Excel Foundations and C2 · Formulas & Functions.
outcomes: Run a repeatable analysis, from a sharp question to a checked answer.
Clean messy exports: text, numbers and dates that aren’t, inconsistent categories, duplicates and blanks.
Combine and reconcile datasets with lookups on several criteria, VSTACK and match-status columns.
Summarise with PivotTables, groupings, slicers and timelines, and with GROUPBY and PIVOTBY.
Use the core techniques: segments, Pareto (ABC), variance, growth and moving averages.
Run what-if analysis and simple forecasts with Goal Seek, data tables, Solver and FORECAST.
Use descriptive statistics, correlation, regression and t-tests, and say honestly what they can’t show.
Write reusable logic with LET and LAMBDA.
